_what: Thirty create drafts staged to measure the rules of TRADE_LEVEL_POLICY.tradeLevelMenu and ENTRY.entry.levels, which stage_strategy_draft's description does not state: fifteen at contract 168.2.0 (2026-11-11 19:05 - 19:34Z) and fifteen at 168.3.0 - six on 2026-11-11 21:44 - 21:46Z (what makes a level one 'this strategy's report yields') and nine on 2026-11-12 00:21 - 00:24Z (the cases the first 21 confounded or never staged: the transform, a non-price reading through `value`, like-for-like offset and timeframe, a Developing column, a spread's base, the level asking bars 'all'). Each staged draft was read back (get_strategy_draft) and discarded; none was committed, and get_strategy_draft read `draft: null` after every discard. The six draft tools are byte-identical between the two contracts (data/contract/stage_strategy_draft/schema_20261111T183243Z.json and schema_20261111T213257Z.json).
